title: IncEventGS: Pose-Free Gaussian Splatting from a Single Event Camera

layout.note: A single free-form drawing: the large greyscale Gaussian scene fills the upper middle, the event stream with its Time arrow sits at the left, below it the measured and synthesised event images and the loss, the camera trajectory curves along the bottom right under two frustums, the bootstrapping loop with the depth model is at the upper right, and a key of arrow and symbol styles runs down the right edge.

lesson: Draw a render-and-compare method as one scene: the learned scene in the middle, the measured input and the synthesised output side by side with a loss node, black operation arrows and blue gradient arrows in parallel along each link, and every arrow and glyph decoded in a key at the edge.
